content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: service=inference-gateway severity=critical - 5xx rate spike detected (>7% over 5m). Pager: @alice (oncall-sre) - https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD12345

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 triggered and routed to escalation-policy 'inference-oncall'. auto-escalation in 6m if unacked.

alice (oncall-sre): acked. I'm looking. seeing EU and USW2 spikes, topo shows increased 502s from edge->gateway.

alice (oncall-sre): quick check: no recent canary deploys in last 30m. Metrics: tail latency ok, but error-rate across pool workers jumping.

bob (eng-runtime): grabbing logs. Likely backpressure from K/V cache misses causing proxy 502s. Pulling kvcache eviction metrics.

alice (oncall-sre): runbook checked: "gateway-5xx-spike" -> step 1: increase gateway retries -> step 2: route traffic to fallback pool -> step 3: coordinate with runtime. I'm moving a slice to fallback.

bob (eng-runtime): confirming: kvcache write queue bursting on EU clusters, eviction rate up 14x. There's a flurry of long tails in cache-store connections. Suspect upstream redis pod restarts around 1762501100.

alice (oncall-sre): temp mitigation: reducing route weight to EU-blue pool by 60%, enabling fallback to legacy-routing. Doing now.

alice (oncall-sre): command: `infra-router set-weight --pool eu-blue --percent 40`

pagerduty-bot: PD note: incident acknowledged by alice at 1762501241. escalation suspended.

dave (support): customer-facing check: any SLO blips? Support dashboard shows 12 ongoing customer requests seeing errors (mostly inference text-gen). I opened a private post to accounts-team for customers with SLA alerts.

carol (product): flagging high-usage customers on EU region. Which models affected? We need to prep comms if >5 customers impacted.

bob (eng-runtime): model-level: all model families hitting gateway, not model-specific. Root cause seems infra kv proxy instability. I can scale dedicated kv-proxy horizontally; will init scale+drain smaller nodes.

alice (oncall-sre): approve scale. Keep me posted. Also enable short-term 429->retry mapping to reduce immediate fanout from clients: `gateway-config set retry-mapping true`

bob (eng-runtime): scaled kv-proxy from 6->12 in eu-west. Watch metric: eviction rate starting to drop.

alice (oncall-sre): error rate falling from 9.1% -> 3.2% in 4m. Nice. Rolling back fallback weight to 80% eu-blue to keep latency stable.

dave (support): update sent to customers on affected accounts: "We observed elevated 5xx errors in EU and USW2; mitigation in progress; minimal impact to majority of requests." (cc product).

carol (product): thanks. Monitoring for persistent impact. Agree on holding external comms to a single update until stable.

bob (eng-runtime): log snippet showing kv-proxy errors for reference:

```
2026-03-15T03:20:11Z [kv-proxy] conn reset by peer, fd=23
2026-03-15T03:20:12Z [kv-proxy] eviction-handler: queue-size=2378 latency_ms=482
2026-03-15T03:20:13Z [gateway] upstream 502 from kv-proxy, req_id=abc123
```

alice (oncall-sre): adding mitigation checklist to PD incident. We'll keep incident open until 5xx rate <1% for 15m. Current: 0.9% over last 5m (USW2 still a bit noisy).

bob (eng-runtime): starting a rolling restart of two kv-proxy nodes in USW2 to clear stale connections. Command: `k8s rollout restart deployment/kv-proxy -n infra --selector=zone=usw2 --max-unavailable=2`

pagerduty-bot: Note: auto-escalation resumed timer reset.

dave (support): customer check: a single enterprise client reported timeouts for batch embedding jobs approx 03:18-03:26 UTC. They were retried and completed. I'll flag their account for SLA review.

carol (product): please collect request IDs and include in post-incident report. I'll draft an initial status update for account managers.

alice (oncall-sre): error-rate stabilized at 0.6% over last 5m. rolling restarts completed. I'll start runbook step to verify cache warmup and evaluate for any regression signals.

bob (eng-runtime): cache hit-rate improved to normal ranges, eviction down. No new pod restarts beyond our controlled ones. Looks healthy.

alice (oncall-sre): preparing handoff. Keeping incident open for another 20m for verification. Next oncall is bob at 04:00 UTC.

alice (oncall-sre): handoff notes:
- root cause: kv-proxy connection storm causing evictions -> gateway upstream 502s
- mitigation: scaled kv-proxy, reduced route weight to fallback, enabled retry-mapping, rolling restarted USW2 kv-proxies
- impact: elevated 5xx from 03:16-03:28 UTC, small number of customer batch jobs retried; no data loss; SLO blip for a handful of clients
- follow-ups: add circuit-breaker to kv-proxy pool, improve kvcache eviction alert thresholds, add runbook step to auto-scale kv-proxy earlier

bob (eng-runtime): acked handoff. I'll take the next shift and own follow-ups. Starting a postmortem draft.

carol (product): thanks team. I'll coordinate customer comms after postmortem draft.

alice (oncall-sre): marking incident PD12345 status: mitigated -> monitoring. I'll set a pinned note in thread with the runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/gateway-5xx-spike

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 state changed to "mitigated" by alice at 1762501548.

alice (oncall-sre): closing chat handoff. If error-rate creeps >1% again I'll re-open.

bob (eng-runtime): adding additional telemetry alerts for kv-proxy queue latency.

carol (product): end of thread — will await postmortem. Thanks. :thumbsup:
